pick.name: Common Paper Order Form + SOW, signed in DocuSeal
pick.what: Standard order form/SOW on top of CSA/PSA, sent for signature via DocuSeal
pick.why: Free, legally coherent with your contract stack, and Claude can fill the cover page from CRM data

alts.name: PandaDoc Free eSign
alts.why: Nicer proposal templates; free (new accounts) is 5 sends/mo, 5 templates
alts.free_limits: 5 sends/mo (older annual free accounts 60/yr), 2 recipients/doc, 5 templates

alts.name: Qwilr
alts.what: Interactive web proposals with quotes, e-sign, payments
alts.why: Pay-later pick for high-ticket services deals: Starter USD 35/user/mo annual

candidates.name: PandaDoc Free eSign
candidates.verdict: If you want WYSIWYG proposal templates

candidates.name: Qwilr
candidates.verdict: When proposals are a sales weapon for USD 10k+ services deals

candidates.name: Zoho Invoice estimates
candidates.verdict: Your invoicing tool can send quotes/estimates

decision: Keep proposals inside the contract system: an order form or SOW plus a one-page scope narrative, signed in DocuSeal. Upgrade to Qwilr only if services deal size justifies interactive proposals.

verify.note: Common Paper SOW and Order Form exist. DocuSeal 10/mo confirmed. PandaDoc alt confirmed: 5 sends/mo (60/yr legacy annual), 2 recipients/doc, 5 templates.
